summary.title: Investigating wrong total in `python3 main.py`
summary.body:
I don't have a root cause yet. The subagent finished but returned no report, so it found no file or line.

I checked the directory myself without changing anything. It has `main.py` and `settings.json`, plus two packages:
- **`app/`**: has `config.py`.
- **`billing/`**: about 30 modules. Several could affect a total, including `rounding.py`, `tax.py`, `discount.py`, `currency.py`, `invoice.py`, `ledger.py` and `balance.py`.

I haven't run `main.py` or read any code yet.

I can run the subagent again with a narrower prompt, or look into it directly. Either way, I'll leave all files as they are until you say otherwise.
